relationships.subject: L. ericoides ethanolic extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Real-time PCR data demonstrated that groups treated with EELE (10%) showed increased Type I collagen, VEGF-A, FGF-2, and AT<sub>1</sub>R and decreased ACE II and receptor MAS.

relationships.subject: L. ericoides ethanolic extract
relationships.evidence_quote: The EELE (10%) significantly reduced the wound area compared to the treatments used for the other groups.

key_findings: Topical 10% EELE reduced wound area and increased collagen, angiogenesis, VEGF-A, FGF-2 expression in mouse excisional wounds.
